author: Daniel G. Brinton
journal: Proceedings of the American Philosophical Society
heading_as_printed: The following is the list of the words sent me. The orthography is German.
place: Musquito Coast (Rama: small island in Blewfield lagoon; Twaka: headwaters of the Tungla or Princeapula rivers; San Blas words picked up on the coast)
about: Word lists of Rama, Twaka and Cuna (San Blas) sent to Brinton by Rev. W. Siebarger, a United Brethren missionary resident on the Musquito coast, and read before the American Philosophical Society on March 6, 1891.
